critical_code_review_comments: bookings.py:1637 (update_booking_dates) — recomputes total_price = rate * nights * rooms, but does NOT touch balance_due or the folio. If the guest has already been charged for the original nights and dates are extended, folio balance will silently drift out of sync with the new total_price. Consider recomputing balance_due = total_price - folio_paid, or emit a folio adjustment.

bookings.py:1687 (split conflict check) — same defect flagged in iter593: excludes only ['cancelled','no_show','checked_out']. A future 'checked_out' status for the same room+dates would falsely allow a split into a still-in-use room. Prefer strict {status: {$nin:['cancelled']}} + explicit occupancy view.

bookings.py:1723 (split) — original booking's payment_status/folio are NOT split proportionally. If original was 'paid' for 500, after split first=200 and second=300 are both marked 'paid' (inherited), meaning first booking looks 250% over-paid and second is 'paid' without any real charge. Recommend: keep folio on original booking, mark second as payment_status='pending' with note.

p0_pack.py:81 (pay redirect) — endpoint is unauthenticated (correct for public link) but has NO rate-limit or per-IP abuse protection. A scraper could rapidly flip statuses to 'opened'. Consider a cheap in-memory rate-limit per tx_id (e.g. only first hit counts).
p0_pack.py:60 (checkout) — still lacks the property_id/booking_id ownership check flagged iter593; iteration didn't address it.

menu_manager.py:26 — `if hidden: ov['hidden'] = True` — a PUT with {hidden:false} sends no changes and returns 422 'section veya hidden gerekli'. This makes it impossible to un-hide a module via PUT; you must DELETE the override. Non-intuitive; consider accepting {hidden:false} to remove the hidden flag.

BookingTimeline.js:1236 — booking-bar has draggable={!bulkMode} which interferes with programmatic click (Playwright mousedown starts a drag not a click). Real users are fine, but automated tests must use dispatch_event('click'). Not a bug, but note for future test authors.

BookingTimeline.js:1997 — split-modal falls back to 'split-no-rooms' when no room is available for the second half, but does NOT expose an option to keep the same room (e.g., a soft split just for accounting). Consider allowing 'same room' selection when the user just wants to split the folio.
